Sub. : Submission of Audio Recording of post conference call on Un-audited Financial 
Results (Standalone & Consolidated) on Q2FY27 (2026-27).  
 
Ref.: Reg. 30 read with Schedule III & all other applicable Regulations, if any, of the SEBI 
(LODR) Regulations, 2015, (“Listing Regulations”) as amended from time to time. 
______________________________________________________________________  
 
Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Kindly refer our letter no. SEC/2110/2026 dtd. October 21, 2026, wherein we notified the Exchanges 
regarding the schedule for the conference call to discuss the Q2FY27 results, which took place today 
i.e. on Thursday, October 29, 2026. Pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of Listing Regulations, the audio 
recordings of the conference call on the Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) of 
the Company for Q2FY27 Results made on October 29, 2026 is available on the website of the 
Company.  
 
Link to access above audio recording is as under: 
 
 
https://apar.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/q2fy27-recording-review-b3b5aa2cb09b/Apar-
Industries-Q2FY27-Earnings-Call-Audio.mp3 
 
We request you to take the above on your record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For APAR Industries Limited 
 
 
 
(Sanjaya Kunder) 
Company Secretary
